4. The facts, in short, as has been in the petition is that the opposite parties as plaintiffs filed a title suit before the learned Assistant Judge, 2nd Court, Gazipur for declaration of title in the land, measuring 1.122 acres out of 1.74 acres of total land alleging inter alia that the original owner of the suit land was Baldha Court of Wards Estate. The C.S. record was prepared correctly in the name of the Manager, Baldha Court of Wards Estate. Thereafter the Government of East Pakistan acquired the land by State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. After Liberation of Bangladesh the land was taken over by the Government of Bangladesh. The predecessor of the plaintiffs, Salim Uddin acquired title in the suit Plot No.6 1 I by the way of lease from the Government and the lease deed was registered vide Deed No.310 dated 09.11.1975. After 15 years the lease became permanent settlement on the basis of the terms of the said deed. After the death of Salim Uddin the plaintiffs are owner of the land by inheritance. The defendant claimed the suit land through R.S. Record in the name of Sabdul Munsi and hence and the case. 

 5. The defendant appeared in the suit by filing Vokalatnama but alleged that due to the learned engaged lawyer's negligence the defendant could not file any written statement and the suit was decreed ex-parte.
